vibe: Linear-like, highly technical, minimal, premium B2B SaaS. Flat hierarchy, ruthless clarity, motion without bloat.

layout_and_spacing.optical_alignment: Ensure icons and text align perfectly on their baseline/center. Use 1px borders to separate content zones (technical grid style).

Header.classes: sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 border-b border-neutral-200/50
Header.details: Include 'Swift Formations' logo (text based, Outfit font, bold), Nav links, and a solid black CTA 'Start Now'.

Hero.details: No centered text. Left-aligned huge H1 (text-5xl md:text-6xl tracking-tighter). Below H1, integrate the interactive Company Name Checker (Shadcn Input + Button). Background should not be a photo. Use CSS grid lines (repeating-linear-gradient) or a subtle mesh gradient to create a technical environment. Include Trustpilot and B-Corp mentions as small, muted text tags.

Company_Name_Checker.details: Use Shadcn Form/Input. Input field for company name, dropdown for extension (optional, .ltd, .co.uk), and submit button. Mock a loading state (setTimeout 1.5s) then display a success/availability message.

How_It_Works.details: 3 steps (Name Check -> Details -> Documents). Use JetBrains Mono for step numbers (01, 02, 03). Use a horizontal flex layout with connecting 1px lines.

Pricing.details: 3 tiers (Essential £12.99, Privacy £39.99, All-Inclusive £89.99). The Privacy tier should have a black background (inverse) with white text. Others have white background with 1px border. Use Lucide icons for checkmarks. Include 'Most Popular' badge.

Benefits.details: col-span-12 md:col-span-8 for primary benefit (Speed & Compliance). col-span-12 md:col-span-4 for secondary (Privacy). Use flat backgrounds, sharp 1px borders. No heavy shadows.

Testimonials.details: 3 columns. Quote text in Manrope, Name in Outfit, Role in JetBrains Mono. Use provided testimonial images for avatars.

FAQ.details: Narrow container (max-w-3xl) centered. No box shadows. Simple 1px bottom borders for each item.

Footer.details: Background #0A0A0A, text #FAFAFA. Massive spacing (py-32). Massive brand text 'SWIFT FORMATIONS' at the bottom.

technical_rules: Use ONLY JavaScript (.js / .jsx), DO NOT use TypeScript (.ts / .tsx).
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button').
Use lucide-react for all icons (e.g., CheckCircle, ArrowRight, Shield).
Use tailwindcss for styling. No custom CSS unless absolutely necessary.
Use framer-motion for micro-interactions (hover, click, simple scroll fades).
